    The finite-string detecting functors #

    For C in Butler--Ringel's W(u,t), this file constructs the detecting quotient

    (1^+ ∩ C^+) / ((1^+ ∩ C^-) + (1^- ∩ C^+))

    as a functor from linear modules over the bound path category to ModuleCat k. Here 1 is the oppositely polarized trivial word 1_(u,not t). The subspace naturality proved in the preceding files gives the induced quotient maps and the functor laws.
